== iOS app installation

- Fixed an issue where installing an iOS app built with an App Store distribution profile failed with an incorrect `AD-403` error asking for a development build. When an installation fails, the error reported by the device now appears instead, such as a code signature verification failure. This applies whether *App signing using Kobiton Certificate (iOS)* is turned on or off for the organization.
